title: 0/1 Knapsack
intuition: Items can either be selected (1) or excluded (0). State tracks index and remaining weight capacity.
recognition_signals: Item selection under weight limit constraints
step_by_step_strategy: State: dp[i][w] is max value choosing from first i items with weight limit w.
Transition: dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], val[i-1] + dp[i-1][w-wt[i-1]]) if wt[i-1] <= w else dp[i-1][w].
complexity: Time: O(n * W), Space: O(n * W) or O(W)
content: Items can either be selected (1) or excluded (0). State tracks index and remaining weight capacity.
